paint.shared.constants

Class PaintStringConstants

  • java.lang.Object
    • paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants

  • public final class PaintStringConstants
extends Object
    Centralizes all string constants used as keys in configuration files, preference stores, and as column headers in CSV tables.

    Using constants instead of string literals prevents typos and ensures consistency across different modules (I/O, validation, UI, and processing).
